classes.name: com.wingedsheep.engine.scenarios.StackObjectCopyEngineTest
case_names: spells are copied before abilities, and each group may be freely ordered
a frozen batch includes existing spell copies exactly once and supports order save and resume
opponents' stack objects and the currently resolving ability are excluded
other pending batch-copy triggers can be copied without copying the resolving one
empty stacks and uncopyable objects create no copies
ability copies emit copy events without triggering or activating again
an ability's new targets use its original source's color, not the copier's color
keeping an ability target retains its old battlefield visit, while explicit reselection captures the new visit
targetless permanent spell copies resolve into token permanents
optional colorless payment may be declined and colored mana cannot substitute for it
paying the optional cost consumes two colorless mana and copies the spell
a departed ability source keeps its last known color when choosing new targets
a copied optional trigger does not inherit a resolution consent choice
ordering answers cannot omit, duplicate, or invent objects

controlled stack copies round-trip with player and ability kinds
